title: Crush Crush decoded save
description: Structured JSON representation of a Crush Crush save file contents.

$schema.description: Editor schema-association hint. Ignored on encode.

Hobby.description: Structural representation of a Hobby's progress in the current reset, keyed by Hobby name.

Achievement.description: Keyed by achievement ID. Save-wide (lifetime tracking) - never appears per-Parallel-Event.

LTE.description: Completed limited-time events (bit index = LTE ID).

PE.description: Parallel events, keyed by PE ID.

LTE.description: Limited-time events, keyed by LTE ID.

AchievementCount.description: Total achievement tiers unlocked across all IDs.

dchk.description: Unconfirmed - likely analytics/checksum, safe to ignore.

ana.ev.description: Unconfirmed - likely analytics, safe to ignore.

ana.vid.description: Unconfirmed - likely analytics, safe to ignore.

SaveFileVersion.description: Unconfirmed - a version number was expected here, not a flag.

CabinFeverSave.description: Whether a "Cabin Fever" save was detected; unlocks Mallory. (Switch-only)

AyanoChibi2017.description: Switch-observed. Likely tracker for the 2017 "Don't Notice Me, Senpai" event.

CurrentPanel.description: Switch-observed. Likely which UI panel/tab was open when the save was written.

TutorialStep.description: Switch-observed. Separate step counter from Tutorial.

TutorialAffection.description: Switch-observed. Likely completion flag for an "affection" tutorial step.

PurchasedTime.description: Meaning undocumented; also appears per-Parallel-Event under Events.PE.<id>.

events.popupinfo.description: Per-event popup display tracking. Passed through as-is, not validated by the tooling.

Unknown.description: Forward-compatibility bucket for root-level keys the schema doesn't recognize yet - preserved losslessly rather than dropped.

anyOf.description: Rare fallback: pending Task entries when no active LTE (Events.Current) was found to attach them to.

bitmask.description: Bit index (string) -> true for set bits. A missing key means that bit is unset - this is sparse, not dense.

unknownField.description: Forward-compat escape hatch for a raw key not yet in tools/save_schema.py's registry. raw_suffix preserves the original int("i")/float("f")/long("")/bare(null) distinction.

bitmaskOrRawFallback.description: Normally a bitmask object; falls back to a raw-preserving wrapper on the rare save where this blob field doesn't decode as expected.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 datetime, or the literal sentinel "N/A" ("needs an unlock requirement"/no history) or "never" (not yet reached).

Start.description: When the LTE task was started.

flingProgress.description: Decoded conversation-state blob, or null when the blob is empty (fling never started, Date == "never").

unknown_1.description: Unconfirmed meaning - possibly a sent-only message counter.

next_message_countdown.description: 4294967292 (0xFFFFFFFC) is a "conversation gated, no countdown running" sentinel, not a literal countdown.

trailing.description: Unparsed trailing bytes as lowercase hex - meaning unconfirmed.

Date.description: Utc-kind. Time of last message received/viewed.
Total Dates gone on across all girls and resets.

Gift.description: Total Gifts given across all girls and resets.

Heart.description: Total Hearts accumulated across all girls and resets.

Poke.description: Total Pokes given across all girls and resets.

gameStateObject.description: Tracks general game state at a root or Parallel Event level.

Date.description: Local-kind. Matches DateUTC to the millisecond.

NSFW.description: Whether the NSFW assets are enabled.

Seconds.description: Elapsed seconds counter - reference point unconfirmed.

TotalTime.description: Lifetime total play time - unit unconfirmed.

Timeline.description: Time Warp PE only - current Timeline the player is in.

TimeCrystalCount.description: Time Warp PE only - Time Crystals obtained this event.

TimelineComplete.description: Undocumented, seen on the Switch sample - meaning unconfirmed.

Boost2EndTime.description: Likely a mobile-version holdover; ad-powered Speed Boost end timestamp. Observed on PC too despite the name.

TimeSkip2EndTime.description: Likely a mobile-version holdover; ad-powered Time Skip end timestamp.

Created.description: Utc-kind. Likely save/account creation timestamp. Defaulted from DateUTC when encoding a PC-sourced JSON to Switch.

DateOffset.description: Likely clock-drift/timezone offset paired with Date/DateUTC.

Covid2020.description: Likely a flag for the short COVID-themed phone fling.

Alphabetic.description: Whether LTE/DLC Girls are sorted alphabetically.

DisableCloud.description: Cloud backup disabled for this save file.

skillObject.description: Hobby-skill levels 0-75, keyed by internal hobby ID (not alphabetical).

Experience.description: Total XP earned in this job.

Locked.description: Whether the Job is unlocked. Yes, really.

Time.description: Total time invested in this Hobby.

TimeL.description: Time invested in this Hobby for the current level.

Dates.description: The Date required for progression this level.

LoveHighMark.description: Time Warp PE only. Highest Love reached this event across resets.

^GiftCount[0-9]*$.description: Count of Gifts given for this level's progression requirement.

^DateCount[0-9]*$.description: Count of Dates gone on for this level's progression requirement.

eventsPeEntry.description: Parallel Event's mirrored state. Anything handled at root with a coherent per-PE reading is handled identically here (tools/save_schema.py's dispatch_entry is shared between root and PE decode/encode) - confirmed real for Bonuses, GirlsUnlocked/PreviouslyUnlocked/CurrentGirl and AvailableJobs inside the Time Warp PE. Save-wide singleton concepts (Achievement, Events.Completed, LTE Task/Token tracking, EventID/LastPesId<N>) have no per-PE analogue and never appear here.

Hobby.description: Each PE uses its own 12-hobby name vocabulary.

Goals.description: Bitmask of goals culminating in unlocking the PE's reward.

Start.description: Utc-kind. When the player started this event.

Unknown.description: Forward-compatibility bucket for this PE's unrecognized keys.

Tasks.description: Task status for the current LTE.

playfabObject.description: Azure PlayFab related state. Assume everything is server-authoritative.

girlsObject.description: Structural representation of a Girl's progress, keyed by name.

PreviouslyUnlocked.description: Unlocked at least once during this save, persists across resets.

Current.description: Index of the currently active Girl.

jobsObject.description: Structural representation of a Job's progress, keyed by Job name.

Available.description: Unlocked jobs. Uses the Job's ID instead of its name.

flingsObject.description: Phone Flings, keyed by numeric fling ID.

Unlocked.description: Which fling IDs are unlocked at all.

Purchased.description: Purchased Core Girl flings, in fixed roster order (not fling ID order).

bonusesObject.description: Shop bonus pricing/quantities. PC-only in practice at root - absent on Switch saves.

albumsObject.description: Memory Album unlock trackers (Switch-only in practice at root). Keyed by album ID (0-5).

additionalProperties.description: Byte index (little-endian) -> bit index within that byte -> true for set bits. Sparse: an absent byte/bit means unset.

rootScalarOrUnknown.description: A plain scalar root-level value (int/float/string/bool) leaking into a Parallel Event's own state - confirmed real (e.g. dchk inside the Time Warp PE) - or the unknown-field wrapper for a genuinely unrecognized key. Not enumerated key-by-key here the way root's own scalar properties are, since any of them could in principle appear per-PE and the set is small/low-value enough not to duplicate.
